lines.text: Many learners say: I will wait you here.
Better: I will wait for you here.
For! I will wait for you here.

data.right: I will wait for you here.

native.tip: En español “te espero”, pero en inglés “wait” lleva “for” antes de la persona: “wait for you.”
native.caption: 🙈 Error común: “I will wait you here.” Antes de la persona, “wait” lleva “for”: “I will wait for you here.” ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “for”. Antes de la persona que esperas va “for”: “wait for you”. Escribe una frase tuya con “wait for” o dila en voz alta: {link}

en.tip: Learners say “te espero”, but before a person “wait” takes “for” in English.
en.caption: Common mistake: “I will wait you here.” Before the person, “wait” takes “for”: “I will wait for you here.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
